description: Shared Renovate policy for the Theokit ecosystem. Extend it with `"extends": ["github>usetheokit/.github"]` — one file to change when the policy changes, rather than nine that drift.

packageRules.description: Peer ranges on our own packages. Dependabot does not look at peerDependencies for npm at all (dependabot-core#1242), which is why two ranges sat three and four majors behind until someone installed them by hand. This rule is the reason this config exists.

Peer ranges on third-party packages get widened instead of replaced. We do not test the old major of our own siblings, so claiming support for it would be dishonest; for react or vite, dropping a major that still works narrows our consumers' options for nothing.
Our own packages, outside peers. They release constantly, and one pull request per package per week is not reviewed, it is rubber-stamped.
Everything else, grouped by what it is rather than by package.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix does not wait for Monday.

github-actions.description: Off, because Dependabot already raises the pull request that advances a pinned action SHA — in this repository's .github/dependabot.yml and in theokit-sdk's. Two bots opening the same pull request is noise, and noise is how a real update gets closed unread. When Dependabot is retired, delete this block rather than editing it, so the removal is a decision someone made rather than a default that drifted back on.
